messages.subject: Project Atlas - COMPLETED
messages.plaintextBody:
All,

I am pleased to confirm that the acquisition of Brampton Leisure Limited completed at 11.52am today. Funds have been received and confirmed, the bank facility has been redeemed, and the documents have been released. Kingsford Group Limited is now the owner of the entire issued share capital of the company. We will circulate the completion bible in due course.

Congratulations to everyone.

James

--
Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
This email is confidential and may be legally privileged.
